label: Aspheric lens

k.help: conic constant (full-lens-corrected design; wizards.solve_asphere supplies (k, A4) per focal length)

tooltip: Plano-convex even asphere, conic + A4 r^4 (revolved exact-sag BSpline + surface_override; extractor verifies <1 um). Defaults are the f=40 BK7@633 design solved for the COMPLETE lens (front asphere + flat exit) by exact ray trace — the old k=-n^2 convention corrected only the front surface and over-corrected the full lens.
